note: exercice intégral de l'option sur environ 4,4 millions d'actions supplémentaires, émises le 19 octobre 2017 ; montant non écrit
quote: Morgan Securities LLC, as underwriter (the "Underwriter"), of Micron Technology, Inc.'s ("Micron") previously consummated public offering of Micron's common stock, par value $0.10 per share (the "Common Stock"), notified Micron of the Underwriter's exercise in full of its option to purchase approximately an additional 4.4 million shares of Common Stock (the "Option Shares")
